observations: Parry selects real/vector/pose precision and dimension by feature. Its cuboid is local-origin centered and stores half-extents, while SharedShape::cuboid forwards its arguments as half-extents. The previously read Avian cuboid constructor halves its full extents before calling this owner. Actual product box producer units, rotations and resolved features remain to be traced.

Cuboid documentation requires positive half-extents, but its public constructor and field do not locally validate those values; SharedShape constructors mostly delegate to native shape owners. Determine actual input admission, native constraints and all callers before treating a hypothetical invalid value as a product defect.

SharedShape is reference-counted with copy-on-write mutation and supports compound children with poses; mesh and convex construction use distinct Result and Option contracts. Native underlying implementation and supported failure propagation are still open. Examples were read, not run; no product build, test, simulation or runtime probe ran.
remaining: Trace product dimensions and frames, native pose/mass/query behavior and input admission, enabled feature selection, shape construction failures and historical aliases. Independently assess every lens.
